description: Warns or bans a player in a project, with a reason kept for the record. A ban makes Paxmod flag every later message from that player id without checking it. A warning is a label only. Replaces any earlier warning or ban on the same player; clear_player_action undoes it. Needs owner, admin or editor access.

reason.description: Why, up to 500 characters. Kept with the action.

user_id.description: The player's id (exact), as the app sends it.

name: set_player_action
title: Warn or ban a player
